notes: Bot selection now uses a clear two-step strategy and capital flow.
Unavailable strategies show investor-friendly status, restriction, cooldown, and eligibility guidance.
Account-specific bot access rules support limits, expiry, activation, and removal from the admin user view.
Bot risk, trading access, cooldown, live-bot capacity, and capital-source terms are presented more clearly.
Modal, notification, wrapping, and responsive presentation have been refined across the bot workflow.
operator_notes: Upload install ZIP contents for new installations.
Use the upgrade ZIP through Admin Settings > Update Center for existing installations.
Never overwrite .env, storage, public/storage, or uploaded user files manually.
Configure real wallet addresses, SMTP, support details, and live chat after install.
